title: team-chat
subHeroTitle: Real-time direct messages and group channels inside your workspace
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ unifies communication directly within your active workspace. Connect via public or private group channels and private DMs, upload cloud attachments, and co-author right next to your active sprints.

sections.title: Scoped channels and rich messaging features
sections.desc: Establish focused channels and private direct messages scoped securely to your organization. Discuss in threaded context, drop files directly onto cloud storage, and interact expressively.

gridItems.title: Direct & Group Channels
gridItems.desc: Establish private 1:1 direct messages or create public/private group rooms (e.g., #engineering) that are strictly locked to your Organization and Space.

gridItems.title: Threaded Conversations
gridItems.desc: Reply directly to specific messages to organize conversations, with automatic scroll-to-original context when tapping a reply preview.

gridItems.title: Cloud File Attachments
gridItems.desc: Drop files, PDFs, images, or designs straight into chat rooms. Attachments upload instantly to secure Amazon S3 cloud storage.

gridItems.title: Emojis & Secure Deletes
gridItems.desc: React using a built-in emoji picker, or delete messages to securely hide them from view using underlying deleted_by tracking.

sections.title: Real-time WebSocket pipeline and group roles
sections.desc: Deliver messages in milliseconds without polling, see active typing indicators, and manage channel memberships and roles using a simple creation wizard.

gridItems.title: No-Lag Socket Delivery
gridItems.desc: Experience lag-free conversations. The real-time WebSocket connection pushes messages instantly without reloading or page refreshes.

gridItems.title: Live Typing Indicators
gridItems.desc: Know exactly when team members are draft replying with real-time indicators (e.g. 'Sarah is typing...') that prevent double text overlap.

gridItems.title: Unread Sidebar Badges
gridItems.desc: Light up channels with red notification counts, tracked accurately using last_read_at timestamps mapping your active read state.

gridItems.title: Roles & Channel Wizard
gridItems.desc: Spin up channels using a creation wizard. Creator admins can add or remove members, rename the group, or leave when needed.

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ brings communication directly into your projects, making discussions and files contextual.
checklistTitle: Keep your team in sync without the noise
checklistDesc: Eliminate status meetings. Integrated chat streams keep everyone aligned in real-time.
checklistItems: Secure Scoped Channels: Public or private group rooms and private DMs isolated to your organization and space context.,
Rich Threaded Messaging: Threaded message replies with auto-scroll navigation, emoji support, and secure message deletion.,
S3 Cloud Attachments: Direct secure file drops (images, PDFs, documents) uploaded instantly to Amazon S3 storage streams.,
Real-Time WebSocket Pipeline: Instant message updates, active typing indicators, and red unread counts with timestamp tracking.,
Group Admin Roles: A wizard to spin up DMs or group rooms, where admin creators can add/remove members and rename channels.
